clue.text: Handsome prince saw this pre-midnight opportunity for repose

definitions.text: Handsome prince saw this pre-midnight opportunity for repose

parts.words: Handsome prince saw this pre-midnight opportunity for repose
parts.note: the fairy-tale prince came upon the slumbering princess of the story, and the phrase also names the restorative rest said to come before midnight

explanation.surface: A fairy-tale prince stumbles on a chance for a nap before midnight.
explanation.walkthrough: The prince in the tale of the sleeping princess literally saw a beauty asleep; the phrase also names the extra-healthy rest that folklore says comes before midnight.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names early-night rest supposed to keep a person looking good.

clue.text: Schoolmaster assists only some of these characters in periods

indicators.note: only some of these characters says the answer is a run of letters lying inside the words that come before

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A schoolmaster helps out with only a few figures in a history lesson.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'these characters in periods' as the definition, but 'these characters' belongs to the indicator: only some of the letters of 'Schoolmaster assists' are used; 'in' links to the definition 'periods'.
explanation.definitionFit: Eras are long spans of history, so they are periods of time.

clue.text: Superior female looking bashful, being taken in hand?

definitions.note: a past participle, guided or shown the way, fitting the passive sense of the clue phrase

parts.note: U is the old abbreviation for upper-class, superior
she is a female person
a bashful person turns red

explanation.surface: A haughty woman blushes as someone takes charge of her.
explanation.walkthrough: U for upper-class or superior is a long-standing British usage; 'looking' only joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To be escorted to a seat by an attendant is to be guided, literally led by the hand.

clue.text: American 'no' upset king

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means the word for no is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: nay is an old word for no
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: An American's refusal annoys a monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns NAY into YAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Yank is informal slang for a person from the United States.

clue.text: Subsequently seen as not real, phoney

indicators.note: phoney means fake, so the letters of not real are a sham arrangement to be reworked

explanation.surface: Something only afterwards shown up as fake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'phoney' rearranges NOTREAL; 'seen as' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean at a time after the present one, afterwards.

clue.text: Hesitation to come before huge god

indicators.note: to come before puts the hesitation sound ahead of the next piece

parts.note: er is the sound of someone hesitating
OS is the clothing abbreviation for outsize, huge

explanation.surface: Someone pauses before a mighty deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Eros is the Greek deity of love.

clue.text: Rickshaw set to be mended with thin piece of wire

indicators.note: mended means repaired, so the letters of rickshaw set are put back together in a new order

explanation.surface: A rickshaw kit is due for a repair using a slender bit of wire.
explanation.definitionFit: In early crystal radio sets the fine wire touching the crystal was named after a feline's bristle.

clue.text: Mother country getting into terrible conspiracy

parts.note: ma is a familiar word for mother
China is a country

indicators.note: terrible signals that the letters of into are in a terrible mess, needing rearranging

explanation.surface: A mother land caught up in some dreadful plot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting into' looks like a container signal, but 'getting' only links and 'into' is the anagram fodder for 'terrible'.
explanation.definitionFit: A scheming plot or intrigue is a conspiracy.

clue.text: Singer in crazy outfit meeting top people

parts.note: mad means crazy
a rig is an outfit of clothing
the A-list is the top tier of celebrities

explanation.surface: A performer in a bizarre costume meets the celebrities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meeting' only joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer of unaccompanied part-songs from the Renaissance is a kind of vocalist.

clue.text: Mischief as eight nuns may go off the rails

indicators.note: going off the rails means losing order, so the letters of as eight nuns are scrambled

explanation.surface: Bad behaviour as a group of eight nuns runs wild.
explanation.definitionFit: Bad behaviour in a child, being naughty, is mischief.

clue.text: Phrasing OTT possibly for this final comment?

indicators.note: possibly says the letters of phrasing OTT may be arranged in another way

explanation.surface: Over-the-top wording might suit a last barb.
explanation.walkthrough: OTT is British shorthand for over the top; here it is just three letters of fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names a pointed remark made while leaving, a last word.

clue.text: Tall man's regularly ignored regrettably

indicators.note: regularly ignored means every other letter of tall man's is dropped, keeping the rest

explanation.surface: A tall man is sadly overlooked again and again.
explanation.walkthrough: Drop the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of TALLMANS.
explanation.definitionFit: The interjection expresses sorrow, used like unfortunately.

clue.text: A frothy talk about heroic doings in story form

indicators.note: about tells the solver to turn the a and frothy talk pieces round together, reading them backwards

parts.note: gas is idle chatter, frothy talk

explanation.surface: Some fluffy chatter about tales of valiant deeds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns AGAS round as a whole.
explanation.definitionFit: An Icelandic or Norse epic recounting heroes' deeds is the classic tale of this kind.

clue.text: Confessed in quiet, having got torn apart

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
riven means split or torn apart

explanation.surface: Someone owns up quietly, having been emotionally shattered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' and 'having got' link the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A penitent who has received absolution after confession is said to be shriven.

clue.text: Diana disguised as a nymph

indicators.note: disguised says the letters of the goddess's name appear in a changed form

explanation.surface: The goddess Diana goes in costume as a water spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth a water spirit of springs and rivers is a nymph.

clue.text: Drunk will hide leg 5 Down today?

definitions.note: 5 Down is the phrase meaning subsequently, so later on this day

indicators.note: will hide means the drunk word conceals the leg word within it

parts.note: tight is slang for drunk
on is the leg side in cricket

explanation.surface: A drunk will conceal a leg, later today perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the leg side is also called the on side, so 'leg' gives ON; the definition refers to 5 Down, LATER ON.
explanation.definitionFit: This evening or night is later on in the present day.

clue.text: Most important one should get 100 for this subject

parts.note: top means chief, most important
I is the Roman numeral one
C is the Roman numeral 100

explanation.surface: The leading student should score full marks on this subject.
explanation.walkthrough: 'should get' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A theme under discussion is a subject.

clue.text: Boy, one who wanders around

indicators.note: around tells the solver to turn the wanderer word round, reading it backwards

parts.note: a nomad is a wanderer

explanation.surface: A lad who roams about.
explanation.definitionFit: Damon is a male first name, so a boy's name.

clue.text: Victor maybe gets to hold nothing

parts.note: to hug is to hold
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A winner gets to clutch nothing at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Victor' looks like a winner, but it is the French novelist's first name.
explanation.definitionFit: Victor is an example of a forename, as in the novelist who wrote Les Misérables.

clue.text: Star admits theft finally — shock!

indicators.note: admits means the star word lets the next letter in, holding it inside

parts.note: the sun is a star

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of theft

explanation.surface: A celebrity confesses to stealing, to everyone's shock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Star' wants to be a celebrity; it is the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: To daze or astonish is to shock.

clue.text: Maiden is clutching a very small bird

indicators.note: clutching means the maiden and is pieces grip the next pieces between them

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A young woman grips a tiny bird.
explanation.walkthrough: MAVIS is an old Scots and poetic name for the song thrush.
explanation.definitionFit: The song thrush, a small songbird, has this old poetic name.

clue.text: Hero, man constructing symbol for Judaism

indicators.note: constructing says the letters of hero and man are built into something new

explanation.surface: A heroic man builds an emblem of the Jewish faith.
explanation.definitionFit: The seven-branched candelabrum of the Temple is an emblem of the Jewish faith.

clue.text: Racist, I fancy, could be using scorn

indicators.note: fancy here means elaborate or fanciful, so the letters of racist and I are rearranged

explanation.surface: I suspect a bigot may be using contempt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I fancy' reads as 'I suppose', but 'I' is fodder and 'fancy' the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Mocking writing that ridicules folly employs scorn and derision.

clue.text: Girl was deceitful and ventured forth

parts.note: Sal is a girl's name, short for Sally
lied means told untruths, was deceitful

explanation.surface: A girl told lies and then set off.
explanation.definitionFit: To set out boldly, or make a sortie, is to venture forth.

clue.text: Beasts? A number will be found in Civil Service

indicators.note: will be found in places the a and number pieces inside the service abbreviation

parts.note: nine is a number

explanation.surface: Some animals are to be found working in Whitehall.
explanation.walkthrough: The Civil Service is Britain's body of government officials. The question mark shows 'Beasts' as a broad hint: dogs are animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogs, members of the dog family, are animals, hence beasts in a loose sense.

clue.text: Brute heading off in one direction

indicators.note: heading off says the first letter of the brute word is removed

parts.note: a beast is a brute

explanation.surface: A savage sets off one way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' looks like departing, but it removes the head letter of BEAST.
explanation.definitionFit: One of the four compass points is a direction.

clue.text: Sign of sorrow or rage

definitions.meaning: a drop from the eye shows sadness
to rush about furiously, as in a mad rush, is to rage

explanation.definitionFit: A drop from the eye shows grief; a frantic rush or fury is the other sense.

clue.text: Filthy place reported — a problem with infection

indicators.note: reported means the pig pen word is to be heard rather than seen, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: a sty, a pig pen, is a filthy place

explanation.surface: A dirty spot has been noted as a cause of infection.
explanation.definitionFit: An inflamed swelling on the eyelid is a bacterial complaint.

clue.text: Court order as before — when lad falls short

indicators.note: before puts as ahead of the shortened lad
falls short means the lad word loses its final letter

parts.note: a boy is a lad

explanation.surface: A court ruling as before, when the lad doesn't measure up.
explanation.walkthrough: An ASBO was a British Anti-Social Behaviour Order, imposed by a court for persistent nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: It was a judicial order restricting someone's conduct, so a court order.

clue.text: First of Acrosses gets one troubled for a very long time

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of acrosses
troubled means disturbed, so the letters of one are reshuffled

explanation.surface: The first across clue gets someone rattled for ages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'troubled' turns ONE into EON.
explanation.definitionFit: An age of immense length, in geology a billion years, is a vast time.

clue.text: Politicians admitting blunder with modern technology in spheres of operation

indicators.note: admitting means the politicians let the next pieces inside

parts.note: Tories are members of Britain's Conservative Party
to err is to blunder
IT is information technology

explanation.surface: Politicians confess to a tech blunder in their areas of responsibility.
explanation.definitionFit: Domains or areas of control are fields in which one operates.

clue.text: Clerics on a sacred meandering around church

indicators.note: around means the shuffled letters go round the church abbreviation
meandering means wandering about, so the letters of on a sacred wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Clergymen on a holy ramble round the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meandering' makes ARDEACONS, which 'around' then wraps about the church abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Senior Anglican clergy below a bishop are churchmen, clerics.
